native_context: Spreadsheet formula interpretation of exported fields
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Spreadsheet formula interpretation of exported fields — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read export quoting, delimiters, cell typing and intended spreadsheet applications/import settings. Identify a recipient who opens attacker-influenced data outside the attacker's own view.
controls.controlled_verification: Create a local CSV with an inert formula marker and a legitimate text control. Import it in the intended application/settings and observe cell interpretation, including the actual quoting/delimiter path. Preserve whether the result was merely authored or actually opened.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A leading formula character in CSV bytes is a candidate, not proof of execution in every spreadsheet. Quoting protects CSV structure but may not force a spreadsheet cell to text.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Choose a format/cell representation appropriate to intended recipients and test round-trip behavior. Retest ordinary data, delimiters/quotes and the original formula interpretation without external commands or links.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
